**Summary**

What this pull request changes, in one or two sentences.

**Related issues**

Links to the issues this addresses, for example "Closes #123". For
anything beyond a small fix, open an issue first so the approach can be
discussed before the code is written.

**Type of change**

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or test-only change

**How it was tested**

How you verified the change: the commands you ran, tests you added, and
any manual checks on Windows or Linux.

**Checklist**

- [ ] The change is focused on a single concern
- [ ] `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` passes
- [ ] New user-visible behavior comes with a test when practical
- [ ] UI strings are wrapped in `qsTr()` and avoid em dashes
- [ ] No unrelated formatting or drive-by changes are included
